description:
Who We Are:   
 CAE Vision: Our vision is to be the worldwide partner of choice in defense and security, and civil aviation by revolutionizing our customers’ training and critical operations with digitally immersive solutions to elevate safety, efficiency and readiness.   
 CAE Defense & Security Mission: CAE's Defense and Security business unit focuses on helping prepare military customers to develop and maintain the highest levels of mission readiness.   
 CAE Values: Empowerment, Innovation, Excellence, Integrity and OneCAE make us who we are and we strive to make a difference in the world while helping each other succeed.   
 
 What We Have to Offer:   
 Comprehensive and competitive benefits package and flexibility that promotes work-life balance   
 A work environment where all employees are valued, respected and safe   
 Freedom to succeed by enabling team members to deliver, take initiatives and make decisions   
 Recognition, professional development, advancement and having fun!   
 
 This position is contingent on Contract Award.   
   
 Summary      

 This role   is performed   as part of a production engineering team supporting the development, integration, and deployment of training systems. Responsibilities include networking,   interfacing   platform simulation applications, and providing   product level   troubleshooting and integration. The position follows the direction of lead engineers, works effectively with general technical guidance, and supports the Training System Support Center (TSSC) through all phases of software design, implementation, testing, and deployment. Engineering solutions must be imaginative, thorough, practical, and aligned with organizational standards and   objectives . 
   

 Essential Duties and Responsibilities  
     

 Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.     
 

 • Performs engineering tasks within a production team environment supporting the development, integration, and deployment of training systems and associated software applications.   
 •   Assists   in networking design, system configuration, and interfacing with platform simulation applications as part of integrated training solution development.   
 • Completes assigned work with general technical direction from lead engineers, ensuring accuracy, quality, and adherence to project timelines.   
 • Communicates project status, technical issues, risks, and recommended solutions or corrective actions to lead engineers and project stakeholders.   
 • Designs,   modifies , develops, writes, and implements software programming applications for training system components.   
 • Installs, configures, and supports software applications and operating systems used within simulation environments.   
 •   Participates   in all phases of software development within the TSSC, including requirements review, design, coding, integration, testing, and deployment, with minimal supervision.   
 • Performs   product level   troubleshooting, diagnoses software and system issues, and supports corrective actions to restore or enhance system functionality.   
 • Develops engineering solutions that are imaginative, thorough, practical, and consistent with established technical processes and organizational   objectives .   
 • Creates and   maintains   accurate   technical documentation such as design notes, installation guides, test procedures, and software support materials.   
 • Collaborates closely with   cross- functional   teams including software, hardware, and integration engineers to support system configuration updates and capability enhancements.   
 • Follows established engineering procedures, configuration management guidelines, and quality standards to ensure consistent and reliable product performance.   

   

 Qualifications and Education Requirements      

 • Bachelor of Science in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline; equivalent experience may be considered.   
 • 1–3 years of experience in software development, systems integration, or engineering support roles.   
 • Foundational knowledge of software programming languages, debugging methods, and structured development practices.   
 • Familiarity with operating systems, networking principles, and software installation processes.   
 • Ability to follow engineering direction and work effectively with general supervision.   
 • Strong   problem solving   skills with the ability to diagnose issues and propose practical solutions.   
 • Effective written and verbal communication skills, especially for reporting status and documenting engineering activities.   
 • Ability to work collaboratively in a   team oriented   technical environment.   

   

 Preferred Skills      

   • Experience with simulation devices, training systems, or   defense related   software environments.   
 • Knowledge of system integration principles and interfacing with simulation platform software.   
 • Experience working with software version control systems or configuration management tools.   
 • Familiarity with distributed computing, networking protocols, or simulation networking technologies.   
 •    Ability to develop or update detailed technical documentation for software and system support.   
 • Experience troubleshooting complex interactions between hardware, software, and integrated systems.   

   

 Security Responsibilities      

 Must   comply with   all company security and data protection / usage policies and procedures.  Personally responsible for proper marking and handling of all information and materials, in any form. Shall not divulge any information, or afford access, to other employees not having a need-to-know. Shall not divulge information outside company without management approval.  All government and proprietary information will be accessed and stored electronically on company provided resources.      

  Incumbent must be eligible for DoD Personal Security Clearance.     

 
     

 Due to U.S. Government contract requirements, only U.S. citizens are eligible for this role.      

   

 Work Environment      

 Work is performed in a subassembly shop, final assembly   labs   and customer sites.  All areas are climate controlled however there are times when individuals will need to work outside in the elements.     

   

 Physical Demands      

 The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.      
 

 • Ability to sit or stand for extended periods while working on computers or performing engineering tasks.   
 • Ability to walk through simulator bays, engineering labs, or training system areas as needed.   
 • May occasionally need to lift and move small equipment or components (up to approximately 25   lbs ).   
   

 Other Duties      

 Please note this job description is not designed to cover or   contain   a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are   required of   the employee for their job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.     

     

 CAE USA Inc. is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to any protected characteristic, including disability and protected veteran status, as defined under federal, state, or local laws.     

       


 Applicants needing reasonable accommodations should contact their recruiter at any point in the recruitment process.  If you need   assistance   to   submit   your application because of incompatible assistive technology or a disability, please contact us at hrops@caemilusa.com   

 
 
 
 About CAE 
 At CAE, our mission is clear: to help make the world a safer place. For nearly 80 years, we’ve driven innovation in simulation, training, and mission readiness to support critical operations worldwide. By leveraging advanced technologies, we empower our customers to operate smarter, faster, and more sustainably. Join a purpose-driven organization where bold ideas are encouraged, collaboration drives progress, and your growth fuels our shared success.
